# eon_restore_account_region_aws_instance_types (Data Source)

Retrieves the EC2 instance types available for restore in a subnet of an AWS restore account region. Use this data source to select an instance type for an EC2 `eon_restore_job`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: List the EC2 instance types available for restore in a subnet
data "eon_restore_account_region_aws_instance_types" "restore" {
  restore_account_id = "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890"
  region             = "us-east-1"
  subnet_id          = "subnet-0123456789abcdef0"
}

# Example: Size the instant-restore host reserve for the volumes being restored
data "eon_restore_account_region_aws_instance_types" "sized" {
  restore_account_id = "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890"
  region             = "us-east-1"
  subnet_id          = "subnet-0123456789abcdef0"
  volume_count       = 2
  total_volume_bytes = 214748364800
}

output "restore_instance_types" {
  description = "EC2 instance types available for restore"
  value       = data.eon_restore_account_region_aws_instance_types.restore.instance_types
}

output "instant_restore_instance_types" {
  description = "Instance types that support instant restore"
  value       = keys(data.eon_restore_account_region_aws_instance_types.sized.instant_restore_mapping)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `region` (String) Region where the subnet is located.
- `restore_account_id` (String) Eon-assigned ID of the restore account.
- `subnet_id` (String) ID of the subnet whose instance types are listed.

### Optional

- `total_volume_bytes` (Number) Optional total size of the guest volumes you plan to restore, in bytes. Used to size the host-memory reserve. If omitted, the server uses a default.
- `volume_count` (Number) Optional number of guest volumes you plan to restore. Used to size the host-memory reserve for instant-restore host selection. If omitted, the server uses a default.

### Read-Only

- `instance_types` (List of String) List of EC2 instance types available for restore.
- `instant_restore_mapping` (Map of String) Map from post-promotion instance type to instant-restore host instance type. Instance types in `instance_types` that are absent from this map are not available for instant restore in the availability zone.
